reviews.title: Bait Switch Don’t Purchase
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for awhile and the $6.00 offer for a year keeps popping up. So I finally decided to ‘claim’ my offer, after tapping the offer the FULL PRICE of $60.00 is the offer! No discount and no option to confirm the discounted offer. Was charged the full amount, complete bait switch!! So be aware if you ‘claim’ your offer you will be charged the full amount! Shame on this company.

reviews.title: Simple and easy to use
reviews.text: If you are into intermittent fasting or anything that needs some sort of timer, this is the one you need. It’s simple. It’s easy to use, and I’ve had it for the longest. It was very fortunate that I came across it because some of the other things that they have like this are a very complicated. This is a simple one. Check it out.

reviews.title: Not Optimized for ADF
reviews.text: I do irregular alternate day fasting based on both what I plan out for the month and how I’m feeling I would love the ability to pick days for 36 hour fasts throughout the month and schedule them. Currently there there’s no way to do that. I can only set up routine fasting on a weekly basis. Better options for fasting that is not intermittent fasting is needed. If you only do daily, intermittent fasting and need to see your windows. This is great for that.

reviews.title: Missing Data
reviews.text: I had enjoyed the FastHabit app, but I got a new phone today, and all of my data is now missing. And this is despite the fact that I pay for the premium version and had all of my data saved to my phones cloud. There is also no way to contact any sort of customer support, if you go to the “Provide Feedback” option, it takes you to a 404 page not found.

reviews.title: Solid, Good App
reviews.text: I’ve been using FastHabit for over a year now, after having tried a handful of others. What I need is just a straight forward tracking of my fasting., start, stop, duration.  I don’t want a social app and support and encouragement. FastHabit does what I need and looks really clean and nice while doing so.

I feel like they set you up so you buy the $6.99 a month one.

reviews.title: Your support site is down
reviews.text:
Great app but your support site is down. 

My feedback is I’d love to have custom notifications throughout my fast. Like setup a 12 hour notification to start my light cardio workout. Or a 16 hour notification to go for a walk. Or a 24 hour notification to make sure to take some electrolytes.

reviews.title: Difficult for professional travelers
reviews.text:
This looks to be a nice app, however, I’m having difficulty with the times. I frequently travel internationally and I am getting tired of having to correct for different time zones. If I don’t, it’s a jumbled mess and looks like I’ve skipped days. To fix this, I would just enter them after the fact, but this has become tedious, and I don’t want to continue doing that. 

If this app had a setting that would allow either an automatic or a locked time zone, it would be incredibly handy. Especially for those who are going multiple days or only eating once a day, such as myself.

reviews.title: Incorrect charge
reviews.text:
I recently signed up for the Fast Habit Tracker after seeing an advertisement offering a discounted rate of $5.99 for a year with 90% off. However, upon signing up, I was unexpectedly charged $59.99 instead.

I have a screenshot of the advertised price as proof and would like to request a full refund for the incorrect charge. Please let me know the steps to process this refund.

I claimed and it they charged me $59.99 and then when I tried contacting them through the app it says page not found. Please rectify this and refund me the difference. I’d be willing to renew my review

reviews.title: Lost data recovered!
reviews.text: I gave this app a bad review due to lost data when I changed iPhones. Quick update....he support person, Hernán, gave me step by step instructions how to recover it.  He was an awesome help and I have all my data now. The app is great too and I managed to lose 30 lbs by using the app to fast twice a week.  Best fasting app out there!

reviews.title: Amazing app!!!
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for almost 3 years, and it is never had any problems. Super easy to use it helps. Keep me on track with my fasting. Whoever designed this app and controls the updates needs to work on every other app out there. It has been perfect. Thank you very much.

reviews.title: Bugs
reviews.text: Cannot submit feedback through the app, cannot schedule a fast in the future - the start can only be today. Weird interface issues like inability of get out of the manual schedule or bizarre choice of color for X to close the window - it’s tiny and black and practically invisible. Also, seems like there is no trial . Could be great, but lack of schedule for longer fasts once every few months while also having intermittent fasts daily is a dealbreaker for me

reviews.title: Don’t fall for the $5.99 offer!
reviews.text: I decided to purchase this app because they claimed a special offer price of $5.99 for a year rather than the regular full price of $59.99.  I clicked purchase and my credit card was immediately hit for the full $59.99.  Now I’m dealing with the refund request process.  Thank goodness I have screen shots but it’s still a hassle.  I expect to be able to trust the Apple App Store to weed out scams.

reviews.title: Love this app!  Not quite a 5 Star

Simple and effective.  Like others have said, it was surprisingly difficult to find an app this functional and straightforward.

Could the developers tweak the app to allow viewing of previous weeks/years, and include weight in the data export?  It’d be 6 stars then!  :)
